title: Register SSF Contracomology path/module IDs in the KG/SSF Learning-Contract
reason: The KG clearance EXT-KG-SSF-20260831 requires SSF to report the concrete SSF module/path IDs back so the KG can register them in the Learning-Contract and NOXIA can reference them. SSF implemented the Contracomology Academy catalogue entry (KON-000004) and returns the IDs.
requested_change: Register the Contracomology introductory course IDs in the KG/SSF Learning-Contract (KXF): path PATH:SSF:KON-EINFUEHRUNG-0001, KXF module LRN:SSF:KON-L1-000001, module KON-L1-000001, mapped to KD:KON:N1 with the canonical concepts CON:L1:zeitform, CON:L1:avi-punkt, CON:L1:oem, CON:L1:paradigma-1, CON:L1:paradigma-2, CON:L1:paradigma-3.
expected_result: The KG Learning-Contract / KXF export lists KON-L1-000001 under KD:KON:N1 so that NOXIA and SSF can reference the canonical module identity.
